title: Replit vs Cursor: Which Should You Use in 2026?
summary: Replit vs Cursor compared in 2026: cloud IDE vs AI code editor. Pricing, features, use cases — plus the full-stack option most readers actually want.
body_markdown: Cursor's Agent mode — using Claude Sonnet, GPT-4o, or the model of your choice — is generally rated higher for code quality and context awareness across large codebases. Replit's Agent is faster for simple apps because it makes more decisions automatically, but that automation limits the quality ceiling on complex requirements. For large, maintainable projects, Cursor wins on quality. For quick simple builds, Replit wins on speed.[Blink](https://blink.new/) supports 200+ AI models including the same frontier models Cursor uses — with a full-stack agent that handles both the application code and its infrastructure, shifting the question from "which generates better code?" to "which ships a better complete product?"
